title: Banana Fritters (Sweet Potato and Banana)
author: Global Pearls, Inc. (Together Women Rise)
desc: A sweet potato blended with water and two ripe bananas, mixed with flour and salt until smooth, and fried by the spoonful in hot oil until golden brown; served hot.
longDesc: From Together Women Rise, credited ‘Recipe and photo credit: Global Pearls, Inc.’ (an organisation, not an individual author). The page lists Cameroon as the country; it appeared in a post on the ‘Proven Platter: Cameroon, July 2021’. The sweet potato is cut small and blended with the water; the peeled bananas are added and blended smooth; the flour and salt are mixed in until smooth. Oil is heated in a pot until hot, a spoonful of the mixture goes in and fries until golden brown. Served hot as an appetiser or dessert. Times and oil quantity are not printed.
ingredients: Oil for frying — quantity not printed
steps: Cut the sweet potato into small pieces. Blend with the water.
Add the peeled bananas and blend till smooth.
Mix in the flour and salt till smooth.
Heat oil in a pot till hot.
Put spoonfuls of the mixture into the oil and fry till golden brown.
Serve hot as an appetiser or dessert.
chefTips: The printed cues are ‘till smooth’ and ‘till golden brown’.
Oil temperature is not printed — test with a drop of batter.
The sweet potato is raw when blended, so give the fritters time to cook through.
commonMistakes: Frying in oil that is not hot enough.
Making the fritters too large to cook through.
healthBenefits: Sweet potato and banana add natural sugar and fibre; frying adds oil.
culturalNote: The page lists the country as Cameroon and gives no region or group. Credit is organisational (Global Pearls, Inc.).
